book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: نيكولاي إيليتش بيلاييف، صاحب بيوت بطرسبورغ، شاب، سمين، عمره اتنين وتلاتين.
sentences.en: Nikolai Ilyich Belyaev, a Petersburg landlord, young, plump, thirty-two.
He entered Madame Irnina's house.

sentences.ar: كان صديقها من سنتين، أو أكتر من صديق، والكل بيعرف.
sentences.en: He had been her friend for two years, or more than a friend, and everyone knew.
And she was not at home.

sentences.ar: وبالصالون، ابنها أليوشا، ولد عمره تمان سنين، نايم عالكنبة، وإجريه بالهوا.
sentences.en: And in the drawing room, her son Alyosha, a boy of eight, lying on the sofa, his legs in the air.
Belyaev said: hello, my friend.
Where is your mother?
The boy said: at the dressmaker's.
Sit with me.

sentences.ar: وقعد بيلاييف، وما كان بيهتم بالولد أبداً، بس هاليوم كان مزاجه منيح.
sentences.en: And Belyaev sat, and had never paid the boy any attention, but that day was in a good mood.

sentences.ar: وحكى معه، عن المدرسة، والمعلمين، والألعاب.
sentences.en: And chatted with him, about school, teachers, games.
And saw in the boy's hand a watch-chain.
He said: where is this from?

sentences.ar: وأليوشا احمر، وخبى إيده، وقال: ما بقدر أقول.
sentences.en: And Alyosha went red, hid his hand, and said: I cannot say.
Belyaev said: why?
He said: a secret.
I cannot.
I swore not to tell.

sentences.ar: قال بيلاييف: أنا كمان بحلف ما أحكي لحدا.
sentences.en: Belyaev said: I too swear not to tell anyone.
On my honour.

sentences.ar: وفكر الولد، وقال: بس ما تحكي لماما.
sentences.en: And the boy thought, and said: but do not tell mama.
Belyaev said: never.

sentences.ar: قال أليوشا، بالهمس: هاي من بابا.
sentences.en: Alyosha said, in a whisper: this is from papa.
And Belyaev's face went white.
The father.
Whom his mother had thrown out.

sentences.ar: اللي الكل بيقول عنه إنه شرير.
sentences.en: Whom everyone called a scoundrel.
He said: you see your father?
Alyosha said: yes.
Every Tuesday and Friday.

sentences.ar: بيليجي، الخادم، بياخدنا أنا وأختي للمحل عند بيبو، وبابا بيستنانا هناك.
sentences.en: Pelageya, the maid, takes my sister and me to the shop by Pepe's, and papa waits for us there.

sentences.ar: وبيشتري لنا فطاير، وبيقعد يحكي معنا.
sentences.en: And he buys us pies, and sits talking with us.
And cries.
And says: your mother is good.
But she torments me.
And Belyaev said: and what else does he say?
Alyosha said: he says... he asks about you.
Belyaev said: about me?
And what does he say?

sentences.ar: قال الولد، وهو خايف: بيقول إنك... إنك خربت حياة أمي، وإنك... إنك رح تدمرنا.
sentences.en: The boy said, afraid: he says that you... that you ruined mama's life, and that you... that you will destroy us.
And Belyaev said: he says so?
About me?

sentences.ar: وبهاللحظة دخلت الأم، وشافت وجه بيلاييف، وقالت: شو فيه؟
sentences.en: And in that moment the mother came in, saw Belyaev's face, and said: what is it?

sentences.ar: وبيلاييف قال، وهو بيرجف من الغضب: زوجك بيشوف الأولاد بالسر!
sentences.en: And Belyaev said, shaking with anger: your husband sees the children in secret!
And talks to them about me!
And Alyosha screamed: you swore!
You swore!
And Belyaev did not hear.

sentences.ar: كان بيصرخ، ويمشي، ويحكي عن شرفه.
sentences.en: He was shouting, pacing, talking of his honour.
And the mother crying, asking the boy: is it true?
Is it true?

sentences.ar: وأليوشا واقف بالزاوية، بيرجف، وبيتطلع ببيلاييف.
sentences.en: And Alyosha stood in the corner, trembling, staring at Belyaev.

sentences.ar: ما كان بيهتم بالصراخ، ولا بأمه، ولا بأبوه.
sentences.en: He did not care about the shouting, nor his mother, nor his father.

sentences.ar: كان بيهتم بشي واحد: هالرجل حلف، وكذب.
sentences.en: He cared about one thing: this man had sworn, and lied.

sentences.ar: وهاي أول مرة بحياته بيواجه الكذب وجهاً لوجه.
sentences.en: And it was the first time in his life he had met a lie face to face.

sentences.ar: وما كان يعرف إنه بالدنيا في أشياء أهم من الشرف، وأتفه.
sentences.en: And he did not know that in the world there are things more important than honour, and more trifling.
